Score out of range
Check the PURE/FAR counts and the chart note count.
The score %1$d is outside %2$d–%3$d, the range for %4$d PURE and %5$d FAR.
Impossible score
Check the score and the chart note count.

The score %1$d is above the chart's maximum %2$d.
Pure Memory score too low
A Pure Memory play scores at least 10'000'000.
The score %1$d is below the Pure Memory minimum of 10'000'000.
Judgment counts exceed the note count
Check PURE, FAR and LOST against the chart note count.
The judgment counts exceed the chart's note count.
PURE %1$d + FAR %2$d + LOST %3$d exceeds the chart's %4$d notes.
Max Recall overflow
Check Max Recall and the judgment counts.
Max Recall %1$d exceeds the allowed maximum %2$d.
Negative counts
Enter 0 or a positive count.
PURE, FAR, LOST and Max Recall cannot be negative.
FR/PM and Max Recall mismatch
Check the clear type and Max Recall.
Max Recall %1$d does not match the chart's %2$d notes.
Full Recall?
Check LOST and the clear type.
LOST should be 0 for Full Recall.
Clear type and LOST mismatch
Check the LOST count, or change the clear type.
This clear type requires at least one LOST.
Judgment counts and note count mismatch
Check the judgment counts against the chart note count.
PURE %1$d + FAR %2$d + LOST %3$d does not match the chart's %4$d notes.
Modifier and clear type mismatch
Check the modifier and the clear type.
Easy Clear, Hard Clear and Normal Clear each require the matching modifier.
Clear type missing
Set the clear type.
Without a clear type, the B50 rules count the play as Track Lost, so it earns no clear bonus.
